testScope.pool: Complete service excursion reached through synthetic Xbox movement from the title-screen water button. Kit pickup, deck routes, three skims, valve routing, return, 360-credit reward and normal reload passed.
testScope.canal: Explicit saved-game fixture begins on shore at the harbor, retaining prior credits. The test then uses controller movement to board, pilot the skiff, pass buoys, collect the dispatch, return, dock and complete the shore handoff for 520 credits.
testScope.boardwalk: Browser verifies start, riding and swept checkpoints. The complete ten-checkpoint sequence and reward are exercised by model tests, not claimed as a full controller-driven browser lap.
testScope.rendering: Actual Chromium/WebGL with software rendering; daytime, rainy-sunset and blue-hour water captures. Reduced motion, local map, phone-width menu, graphics-context recovery and disconnect behavior passed.
testScope.audio: Existing single music transport and bounded voices remain; water ambience and cues share the existing mixer.
testScope.regressions: The maintained Coastal Pulse and Homecoming browser journeys passed with preserved saves and original gameplay.

water.method: Analytical submerged-tile refraction, depth tint, caustic-style interference, normal ripples and existing environment-map reflections. No ray tracing or live-scene mirror is claimed.
water.limits: One authored waterfront. Pool service happens from the deck. A pedal skiff is controllable in the canal. Swimming, underwater traversal and an open ocean are not implemented.

qualityReview: Actual test screenshots were reviewed. The waterfront and vehicle remain stylized procedural art; overall AAA art approval and real-device frame-rate gates remain open.
publication: Acceptance complete; master merge and public-file verification are recorded separately in the release pull request.
